how: Kabuki Springs and Spa in Japantown offers a communal Japanese-style bathhouse with a cedar dry sauna, steam room and hot and cold pools open daily.
The San Francisco Disc Golf Club maintains an 18-hole course in Golden Gate Park with multiple pin positions per hole.
Kala Art Institute in Berkeley lists adult printmaking classes including Lithography for Ceramics alongside etching and monotype courses.
The Crucible's Stoneworking department in West Oakland teaches hand-carving with hammer and chisel in beginner Creative Carving classes, with tools provided.
Shokunin ran a hands-on kintsugi workshop at the San Francisco Zen Center, one of several periodic kintsugi and Japanese mending workshops listed in the city.
Mannys venue in the Mission hosts ticketed close-up magic and mind-reading shows, and The Magic Patio runs regular evening and family magic shows.
San Francisco Buddhist Center runs a Saturday morning qigong and meditation session, and other Bay Area venues list qigong sessions.
Oakland Lacrosse Club hosts adult 4v4 lacrosse social runs at Sofive Indoor Soccer Field in Alameda, open to all experience levels.
Academy of Art University offers a School of Animation and Visual Effects with a 2D animation specialisation (hand-drawn and digital) taught by working professionals, as a degree programme.
The San Francisco Conservatory of Music teaches harp, including a five-day Harp Immersive summer programme for ages 12-19 alongside conservatory study.
Sports Basement Stonestown hosts a weekly Wednesday evening Stonestown Run Club, and other free run clubs meet at stores and venues across the city.
Avedano Holly Park Market in Bernal Heights runs Sunday Butchery for Adults classes breaking down a whole hog or lamb into kitchen-ready cuts, with meat to take home.
venue: Avedano Holly Park Market (The Udder Room)

how: Wok Wiz runs guided Chinatown walking tours including an eat-your-way-through-Chinatown food tour with tastings, a tea shop visit and a hosted dim sum lunch.
The San Francisco Public Library Deaf Services Center runs recurring American Sign Language workshops (ASL Basics, Introduction to ASL), plus online ASL learning and ASL meetups.
venue: San Francisco Public Library Deaf Services Center (Main Library)

how: San Francisco Public Library branches periodically run free macrame workshops (rainbow wall hangers, plant hangers, bracelets) with materials provided.
San Francisco Public Library has offered a beginner Discover Hangeul workshop on the Korean alphabet and runs Korean culture programming; ongoing Korean classes are not confirmed.

how: San Francisco Public Library has offered a two-session Chinese ink painting workshop teaching basic brush skills; listing is dated 2023.
The Aurora Mandolin Orchestra is a long-running community plucked-string orchestra in the Bay Area (almost 100 years) that performs at libraries, museums and festivals.
San Francisco Public Library has hosted an Urban Foraging workshop at Bernal Heights Branch on foraging local plants, alongside foraging and mushroom talks; guided foraging is occasional.
The San Francisco Guzheng Music Society (formed 1982) promotes guzheng music through public performances at venues such as the Sunset Branch Library; lesson availability is not confirmed on the page.
San Francisco Public Library has hosted a Batik Filipinx workshop (listing dated 2022); batik is taught only occasionally in library craft programmes.
